lenses.name: Population density
lenses.description: Census 2011 district population divided by the official PCA district area, then the area-weighted mean over the districts in the hex. Every hex of one district has the same density, so dense cities inside large districts are averaged out.

lenses.name: Settlement density (modelled)
lenses.description: Gridded Population of the World v4, 2020 (NASA SEDAC), sampled from the NASA GIBS colour-binned layer and averaged in the hex. The colour map stops at ≥ 1,000 people/km², so dense urban cores are capped at 1,000. This is a modelled estimate, not a census count.

lenses.name: Urbanisation
lenses.description: Census 2011 urban population as a share of district population (PCA). National value 31.1%.

lenses.name: Sex ratio
lenses.description: Census 2011 females per 1,000 males (all ages). The colour scale centres on the national value, 943.

lenses.name: Child sex ratio (0–6)
lenses.description: Census 2011 (PCA): girls per 1,000 boys aged 0–6. National value 918. The scale centres on 918.

lenses.name: Sex ratio at birth
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): sex ratio at birth for children born in the last five years. Survey estimate; small districts have wide confidence intervals.

lenses.name: Scheduled Tribes
lenses.description: Census 2011 Scheduled Tribe population as a share of district population.

lenses.name: Income per person
lenses.description: Per-capita Net State Domestic Product at current prices, 2023-24 (MoSPI). State level: every hex of a state has the state value.

lenses.name: Night lights
lenses.description: Brightness of the NASA Black Marble 2016 night-light composite (VIIRS), sampled from the GIBS image tiles. This is a relative visual index, not calibrated radiance. Night lights track electrification, settlement and economic activity.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.description: PLFS 2025 unemployment rate, usual status, age 15+. State level.

lenses.name: Women at work
lenses.description: PLFS 2025 worker population ratio for women aged 15+, usual status. State level.

lenses.name: Manufacturing share
lenses.description: Manufacturing share of Gross State Value Added, current prices, 2023-24 (MoSPI). State level.

lenses.name: Non-farm workers
lenses.description: Census 2011 'other workers' (not cultivators, agricultural labourers or household industry) as a share of all workers: manufacturing, trade, services, government.

lenses.name: Households with a car
lenses.description: Census 2011 households that own a car, jeep or van, per 100 households (PCA household count).

lenses.name: Literacy
lenses.description: Census 2011 literacy rate, official definition: literates divided by the population aged 7 and over (PCA). National value 72.98%.

lenses.name: Female literacy
lenses.description: Census 2011 female literates divided by the female population aged 7 and over (PCA).

lenses.name: Women's literacy
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): literate women aged 15–49.

lenses.name: Women with 10+ years of school
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): women aged 15–49 with 10 or more years of schooling.

lenses.name: Graduates
lenses.description: Census 2011 graduates and above as a share of the persons in the education-level table of the district.

lenses.name: Internet at home (2011)
lenses.description: Census 2011 households with an internet connection per 100 households. A 2011 baseline: access has grown very much since.

lenses.name: Child stunting
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): children under five who are stunted (height-for-age).

lenses.name: Institutional births
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): births in the 5 years before the survey that took place in a health facility.

lenses.name: Full immunisation
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): children aged 12–23 months fully vaccinated (based on card or mother's recall).

lenses.name: Health insurance
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): households with any member covered by a health insurance or financing scheme.

lenses.name: Anaemia in women
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): all women aged 15–49 who are anaemic.

lenses.name: Improved sanitation
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): population in households that use an improved sanitation facility.

lenses.name: Improved drinking water
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): population in households with an improved drinking-water source.

lenses.name: Clean cooking fuel
lenses.description: NFHS-5 (2019–21): population in households that cook with clean fuel (electricity, LPG/natural gas, biogas).

lenses.name: Infant mortality
lenses.description: Sample Registration System 2024: infant mortality rate. State level; smaller states use a 3-year average.

lenses.name: Life expectancy
lenses.description: SRS abridged life tables 2020–24: life expectancy at birth. State level; published for the larger states only.

lenses.name: Elevation
lenses.description: Mean elevation of the hex from AWS Terrain Tiles (SRTM/GMTED-derived, zoom 7, ~1.2 km pixels).

lenses.name: Forest & woodland
lenses.description: MODIS land cover 2023 (IGBP classes 1–5 forest and 8 woody savanna) share of the hex sample points. Satellite classification at ~500 m; it differs from the Forest Survey of India definition of forest cover.

lenses.name: Cropland
lenses.description: MODIS land cover 2023: cropland (12) and cropland/natural mosaic (14) share of the hex sample points.

lenses.name: Forest cover (ISFR)
lenses.description: India State of Forest Report 2023 (Forest Survey of India): forest cover (very dense + moderately dense + open forest) as a share of district area. Official satellite-based assessment.

lenses.name: Foodgrain output
lenses.description: District foodgrain production 2022-23 (Directorate of Economics & Statistics, crop production statistics) per km² of district. District sums run above the national estimate, so use this for the pattern, not totals.

lenses.name: Rice yield
lenses.description: District rice yield 2022-23 (DES crop production statistics). Districts with very small rice area can show unstable values.

lenses.name: Wheat yield
lenses.description: District wheat yield 2022-23 (DES crop production statistics).

lenses.name: Sugarcane output
lenses.description: District sugarcane production 2022-23 per km² of district (DES).

lenses.name: Cotton output
lenses.description: District cotton production 2022-23 per km² of district (DES).

lenses.name: Mineral production
lenses.description: Value of mineral production 2023-24 (provisional, Indian Bureau of Mines; excludes atomic minerals, fuel minerals and minor minerals as defined by IBM), divided by state area. State level.

lenses.name: Coal production
lenses.unit: million tonnes per km² of state
lenses.description: Raw coal production 2024-25 (provisional, Ministry of Coal Directory) divided by state area. State level; only coal-producing states have values.

lenses.name: Irrigated farmland
lenses.description: Net irrigated area as a share of net sown area, Land Use Statistics 2022-23. State level.

lenses.name: Foodgrain yield
lenses.description: Foodgrain production per hectare of foodgrain area, 2023-24 (Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare). State level.

lenses.name: Annual rainfall
lenses.description: WorldClim 2.1 (1970–2000 climate normals, 10 arc-minute) annual precipitation averaged in the hex.

lenses.name: Monsoon dependence
lenses.description: Share of annual rainfall that falls in June–September (WorldClim 2.1 monthly normals).

lenses.name: Hottest month
lenses.description: Mean temperature of the hottest month, WorldClim 2.1 normals 1970–2000.

lenses.name: Flood frequency
lenses.description: Number of large flood events 1985–2003 (Dartmouth Flood Observatory extents) from SEDAC Global Natural Disaster Hotspots, averaged in the hex. Old period; use only for broad patterns.

lenses.name: Drought frequency
lenses.description: Number of drought events 1980–2000 (weighted anomaly of standardized precipitation) from SEDAC Global Natural Disaster Hotspots.

lenses.name: Cyclone frequency
lenses.description: Tropical cyclone frequency 1980–2000 from SEDAC Global Natural Disaster Hotspots (UNEP/GRID-Europe).

lenses.name: Landslide hazard
lenses.description: Landslide hazard class from SEDAC Global Natural Disaster Hotspots (NGI): combines slope, soil, precipitation and seismic triggers.

lenses.name: Religious diversity
lenses.description: Census 2011 religion counts: 1 − Σ share², the probability that two random residents of the district report different religions. 0 means one religion only. This lens shows diversity, not any one religion.

lenses.name: Non-farm jobs beyond urbanisation
lenses.description: Which mostly rural districts still give many people non-farm work? Score = how far the district is above (+) or below (−) the value that Urban share, Population density (log) predict, in standard deviations of the residual. Fit: ordinary least squares, n = 640, R² = 0.64. Outcome: Non-farm workers (census2011_district). A score is not a cause: irrigation, policy, history and data error also move it.

lenses.name: Graduates beyond wealth
lenses.description: Which districts produce more graduates than their wealth and urbanisation predict? Score = how far the district is above (+) or below (−) the value that Urban share, Population density (log), Households with a two-wheeler, Households with electric light predict, in standard deviations of the residual. Fit: ordinary least squares, n = 640, R² = 0.68. Outcome: Graduates (census2011_district). A score is not a cause: irrigation, policy, history and data error also move it.

lenses.name: Female literacy beyond wealth
lenses.description: Where are women more literate than household wealth predicts? Score = how far the district is above (+) or below (−) the value that Urban share, Households with a two-wheeler, Households with electric light predict, in standard deviations of the residual. Fit: ordinary least squares, n = 640, R² = 0.42. Outcome: Female literacy (7+) (census2011_district). A score is not a cause: irrigation, policy, history and data error also move it.

lenses.name: Grain yield beyond climate
lenses.description: Which districts harvest more grain per hectare than their rain and heat predict? Score = how far the district is above (+) or below (−) the value that Annual rainfall (log), Mean temperature, Elevation, Maize share of grain area, Pulses share of grain area predict, in standard deviations of the residual. Fit: ordinary least squares, n = 692, R² = 0.45. Outcome: Foodgrain yield (crop_district). A score is not a cause: irrigation, policy, history and data error also move it. Left out as source errors (rice or wheat yield above 7 t/ha): North Goa, South Goa.

lenses.name: Child growth beyond living standards
lenses.description: Where do fewer children suffer stunting than household living standards predict? Score = how far the district is above (+) or below (−) the value that Clean cooking fuel, Improved sanitation, Electricity, Women with 10+ years of school predict, in standard deviations of the residual. Fit: ordinary least squares, n = 693, R² = 0.40. Outcome: Child stunting (nfhs5_district). A score is not a cause: irrigation, policy, history and data error also move it.

lenses.name: Women's schooling beyond wealth
lenses.description: Where do women complete 10 years of school more often than living standards predict? Score = how far the district is above (+) or below (−) the value that Clean cooking fuel, Electricity, Improved sanitation predict, in standard deviations of the residual. Fit: ordinary least squares, n = 693, R² = 0.52. Outcome: Women with 10+ years of school (nfhs5_district). A score is not a cause: irrigation, policy, history and data error also move it.

lenses.name: Exports beyond economy size
lenses.description: Which states export more than the size of their economy predicts? Score = how far the district is above (+) or below (−) the value that GSDP (log) predict, in standard deviations of the residual. Fit: ordinary least squares, n = 29, R² = 0.85. Outcome: Merchandise exports (log) (exports_state). A score is not a cause: irrigation, policy, history and data error also move it.

lenses.name: Top institutions beyond population
lenses.description: Which states hold more NIRF-ranked institutions than their population predicts? Score = how far the district is above (+) or below (−) the value that Population 2011 (log) predict, in standard deviations of the residual. Fit: ordinary least squares, n = 36, R² = 0.51. Outcome: NIRF 2025 ranked institutions (log 1+n) (NIRF 2025). A score is not a cause: irrigation, policy, history and data error also move it.

lenses.name: Population density over time
lenses.description: Census population of each district for each census year, on 2011 district boundaries (Census 2011 Table A-2), divided by the 2011 district area. Colours use one scale for all years.

lenses.name: Urbanisation over time
lenses.description: Urban population as a share of state population, census years, on present state boundaries. State level. Colours use one scale for all years.

notes.1991: MoSPI SSES 2017 Table 1.7 (ORGI), boundaries of the census year
notes.2001: MoSPI SSES 2017 Table 1.7 (ORGI), boundaries of the census year

lenses.name: Literacy over time
lenses.description: Census literacy rate by state. The definition changes: 1951–1971 use the population aged 5+, 1981 onwards the population aged 7+. Values before 2011 are on the state boundaries of the census year, so states that changed shape (for example Kerala before 1956) do not compare exactly. State level. Colours use one scale for all years.

notes.1951: Economic Survey 2021-22 Table 8.5 (ORGI), boundaries of the census year; 5+; all ages (West Bengal 1951 includes age 0-4)
notes.1961: 5+; Economic Survey 2021-22 Table 8.5 (ORGI), boundaries of the census year
notes.1971: 5+; Economic Survey 2021-22 Table 8.5 (ORGI), boundaries of the census year
notes.1981: 7+; Economic Survey 2021-22 Table 8.5 (ORGI), boundaries of the census year
notes.1991: 7+; Economic Survey 2021-22 Table 8.5 (ORGI), boundaries of the census year
notes.2001: 7+; Economic Survey 2021-22 Table 8.5 (ORGI), boundaries of the census year
notes.2011: 7+; 2011 district counts: literate / (population - age 0-6), present boundaries

lenses.name: Sex ratio over time
lenses.description: Census females per 1,000 males by state, census years. State level. Colours use one scale for all years.

lenses.name: Income per person over time
lenses.description: Per-capita Net State Domestic Product at constant 2011-12 prices (MoSPI), every year from 2011-12. Constant prices remove inflation, so the years compare. State level. Colours use one scale for all years.

lenses.name: Population growth 1951–2011
lenses.description: Census 2011 population divided by the 1951 population of the same area (2011 district boundaries, Census Table A-2).

lenses.name: Population growth 2001–2011
lenses.description: Decadal population growth 2001–2011 on 2011 district boundaries (Census Table A-2). National value 17.7%.

lenses.name: Real income growth since 2011-12
lenses.description: Compound annual growth of per-capita NSDP at constant 2011-12 prices, 2011-12 to 2024-25 (or the latest year a state reports). State level.

lenses.name: Food yield
lenses.unit: tonnes of foodgrain (district statistics 2022-23) per km²
lenses.description: District foodgrain production 2022-23 (DES crop production statistics; rice, wheat, coarse cereals, pulses), spread inside each district by hex cropland area (MODIS 2023). District sums run above the national estimate (for example rice 148.6 Mt against 135.8 Mt), so compare places, not totals.

lenses.name: Production yield
lenses.unit: ₹ industrial GSVA (2023-24, current prices) per km²
lenses.description: Industrial GSVA (mining, manufacturing, electricity/gas/water, construction), 2023-24, MoSPI. Spread inside each state by Census 2011 non-farm workers (household industry + other workers). The spread is a model.

lenses.name: Gold yield
lenses.description: Gross State Domestic Product 2023-24 at current prices (MoSPI), spread inside each state by Census 2011 non-farm workers. Check against Maharashtra's official district GDP 2022-23 (33 districts): log correlation r = 0.99, median error 9%. Night lights as the weight did worse (r = 0.52, median error 41%), because the Black Marble image saturates in big cities.

lenses.name: Science yield
lenses.description: Graduates and above in the Census 2011 education table, spread over each district's hexes by area. Universities and research institutes appear as campus resources on the map.

lenses.name: Culture yield
lenses.description: UNESCO World Heritage Sites and protected monuments with an ASI monument ID in Wikidata (2,913 centrally protected of about 3,700, plus 1,571 state-protected) located in the hex. Wikidata coverage differs between states, so low counts can mean missing records.

lenses.name: Faith yield
lenses.description: Protected monuments (ASI monument ID in Wikidata) whose Wikidata class is a place of worship, stupa, monastery or dargah (P31/P279*), located in the hex. This counts protected religious heritage buildings; it does not measure religious practice or belief. Wikidata coverage differs between states.

lenses.name: Health yield
lenses.unit: public hospital beds (31 March 2025) per km²
lenses.description: Hex pips: mean percentile of six NFHS-5 (2019–21) district indicators — institutional births, full immunisation, sanitation, insurance (higher is better) and stunting, anaemia in women (lower is better). State totals: public hospital beds (district, sub-district hospitals and medical colleges, RHS 2025).

lenses.name: Infrastructure yield
lenses.description: Hex score: power capacity (GW) + airport passengers (millions) + port cargo (10 Mt units) in the hex. State totals: installed power-plant capacity in the WRI Global Power Plant Database (2019).
